title: SEEN_DIGESTS HashMap grows unbounded between purges
description: src/inbox.rs:20-22. The SEEN_DIGESTS static HashMap is purged lazily during verify_and_fetch_actor (line 611), but only when a new delivery arrives. Under sustained traffic this is fine, but if traffic stops after a burst, entries linger until the next delivery. More importantly, retain() iterates the entire map on every inbound delivery — O(n) where n is the number of entries accumulated in the 10-minute window. For a single-user server receiving maybe dozens of deliveries per minute this is completely fine, but the growth pattern is worth noting. No action needed for current scale.
